question: Which of the following awards is NOT conferred for excellence in dance?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lalit Kala Akademi Award**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The **Lalit Kala Akademi Award** is conferred for excellence in the field of visual arts, including painting, sculpture, and other forms of fine arts, not dance.
 
• The **Sangeet Natak Akademi Award**, established in 1952, is given for exceptional work in the fields of music, dance, and drama.
 
• The **Kalidas Samman Award**, instituted by the Government of Madhya Pradesh, honors outstanding achievements in classical music, classical dance, theatre, and visual arts.
 
• The **Padma Shree Award** is one of India’s highest civilian honors and is given for distinguished service in various fields, including arts, which encompasses dance.
 
• The **Lalit Kala Akademi Award** specifically focuses on visual arts and has no connection to dance, making it the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Lalit Kala Akademi**

 
 
• Established in 1954, the Lalit Kala Akademi (National Academy of Art) promotes and propagates understanding of Indian art both within and outside the country.
 
• The Akademi organizes national and international exhibitions and awards scholarships and fellowships to support artists.
 
• It operates under the Ministry of Culture, Government of India.
 
 
 
• **Sangeet Natak Akademi**
 
 
• India’s national academy for music, dance, and drama, it was set up in 1953.
 
• The Sangeet Natak Akademi Awards are considered the highest national recognition for performing artists, including dancers.
 
 
 
• **Kalidas Samman**
 
 
• Instituted in 1980, the Kalidas Samman is awarded annually by the Madhya Pradesh government.
 
• It is given in fields such as classical dance, classical music, theatre, and visual arts.
 
 
 
• **Padma Awards**
 
 
• The Padma Awards, namely Padma Vibhushan, Padma Bhushan, and Padma Shree, are among the highest civilian honors of India.
 
• They are awarded for exceptional and distinguished service in various domains, including arts, education, sports, and more.
